arxiv-2106-09086.title: Learned Belief Search: Efficiently Improving Policies in Partially Observable Settings
arxiv-2106-09086.creator: Hengyuan Hu*, Adam Lerer*, Noam Brown, Jakob Foerster
arxiv-2106-09086.description: Abstract Search is an important tool for computing effective policies in single- and multi-agent environments, and has been crucial for achieving superhuman performance in several benchmark fully and partially observable games. However, one major limitation of prior search approaches for partially observable environments is that the computational cost scales poorly with the amount of hidden information.

arxiv-2208-05559.title: Comparing Channel Restrictions of Communicating State Machines, High-level Message Sequence Charts, and Multiparty Session Types
arxiv-2208-05559.creator: Felix Stutz Damien Zufferey
arxiv-2208-05559.description: Abstract Communicating state machines provide a formal foundation for distributed computation. Unfortunately, they are Turing-complete and, thus, challenging to analyse. In this paper, we classify restrictions on channels which have been proposed to work around the undecidability of verification questions. We compare half-duplex communication, existential B B -boundedness, and k k -synchronisability.

arxiv-2307-04868.title: Leveraging an Alignment Set in Tackling \titlebreak Instance-Dependent Label Noise
arxiv-2307-04868.creator: Donna Tjandra, Jenna Wiens
arxiv-2307-04868.description: Abstract Noisy training labels can hurt model performance. Most approaches that aim to address label noise assume label noise is independent from the input features. In practice, however, label noise is often feature or instance-dependent , and therefore biased (i.e., some instances are more likely to be mislabeled than others). E.g.

arxiv-2311-16808.title: HI, FRB, what’s your z: The first FRB host galaxy redshift from radio observations
arxiv-2311-16808.creator: M. Glowacki, A. Bera, K. Lee-Waddell, A. T. Deller, T. Dial, K. Gourdji, S. Simha, M. Caleb, L. Marnoch, J. Xavier Prochaska, S. D. Ryder, R. M. Shannon, N. Tejos
arxiv-2311-16808.description: Abstract Identification and follow up observations of the host galaxies of fast radio bursts (FRBs) not only help us understand the environments in which the FRB progenitors reside, but also provide a unique way of probing the cosmological parameters using the dispersion measures of FRBs and distances to their origin.

arxiv-2412-05138.title: Supply Chain Insecurity: The Lack of Integrity Protection in SBOM Solutions
arxiv-2412-05138.creator: Can Özkan, Xinhai Zou, Dave Singelée
arxiv-2412-05138.description: Abstract The SolarWinds attack, which exploited weaknesses in a software update mechanism, highlights the critical need for organizations to have better visibility into their software dependencies and potential vulnerabilities associated with them. The Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) is paramount in ensuring software supply chain security.

arxiv-2501-02325.title: Revisiting compactness for district plans
arxiv-2501-02325.creator: Kristopher Tapp
arxiv-2501-02325.description: Abstract . Modern sampling methods create ensembles of district maps that score well on discrete compactness scores, whereas the Polsby-Popper and other shape-based scores remain highly relevant for building fair maps and litigating unfair ones. The aim of this paper is twofold.

arxiv-2503-15613.title: Prompt Periodicity in the GRB 211211A Precursor: Black-hole or magnetar engine?
arxiv-2503-15613.creator: Gavin P. Lamb, Thomas Baxter, Conor M. B. Omand, Dimple, Zoë McGrath, Cairns Turnbull, Eric Burns, Hamid Hamidani, Ilya Mandel, Kim L. Page, Stephan Rosswog, Nikhil Sarin, Andrew Blain, Laurence Datrier, Shiho Kobayashi, Andrew Levan, Rhaana Starling, Benjamin Gompertz, Nusrin Habeeb, Khang Nguyen,
arxiv-2503-15613.description: Abstract The merger origin long GRB 211211A was a class (re-)defining event. A precursor was identified with a ∼ 1 \sim 1 s separation from the main burst, as well as a claimed candidate quasi-periodic oscillation (QPO) with a frequency ∼ 20 \sim 20 Hz. Here, we explore the implications of the precursor, assuming the quasi-periodicity is real.

arxiv-2508-09747.title: A Machine Learning Approach to Predict Biological Age and its Longitudinal Drivers
arxiv-2508-09747.creator: Nazira Dunbayeva, Yulong Li, Yutong Xie, Imran Razzak
arxiv-2508-09747.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nazira Dunbayeva, Yulong Li, Yutong Xie, Imran Razzak. Predicting an individual’s aging trajectory is a central challenge in preventative medicine and bioinformatics. While machine learning models can predict chronological age from biomarkers, they often fail to capture the dynamic, longitudinal nature of the aging process. In this work, we developed and validated a machine learning pipeline to predict age using a longitudinal cohort with data from two distinct time periods (2019-2020 and 2021-2022).

arxiv-2511-00171.title: CompAgent: An Agentic Framework for Visual Compliance Verification
arxiv-2511-00171.creator: Rahul Ghosh, Baishali Chaudhury, Hari Prasanna Das, Meghana Ashok
arxiv-2511-00171.description: Abstract Visual compliance verification is a critical yet underexplored problem in computer vision, especially in domains such as media, entertainment, and advertising where content must adhere to complex and evolving policy rules. Existing methods often rely on task-specific deep learning models trained on manually labeled datasets, which are costly to build and limited in generalizability.

arxiv-2602-16166.title: Discovering Unknown Inverter Governing Equations via Physics-Informed Sparse Machine Learning
arxiv-2602-16166.creator: Jialin Zheng, Ruhaan Batta
arxiv-2602-16166.description: Abstract Discovering the unknown governing equations of grid-connected inverters from external measurements holds significant attraction for analyzing modern inverter-intensive power systems. However, existing methods struggle to balance the identification of unmodeled nonlinearities with the preservation of physical consistency. To address this, this paper proposes a Physics-Informed Sparse Machine Learning (PISML) framework.

pmc-11439021.title: Design of modified long short-term memory-based zebra optimization algorithm for limiting the issue of SHEPWM in multi-level inverter
pmc-11439021.creator: G. Krithiga, S. Senthilkumar, Mohammed Alharbi, S. P. Mangaiyarkarasi
pmc-11439021.description: This research work proposes unique MLSTM-ZOA to quickly measure SAs for an MLI. Here, the main objective lies in minimizing the THD with consideration of three parameters such as MI, number of pulses per quarter cycle, and duty cycle.

pmc-12668303.title: The Role of Intimate Dipole Carbonyl–Carbonyl and Hydrogen–Carbonyl Interactions in the Stereocomplexation and Crystallization: The Case of Poly(Cyclohexene Carbonate)
pmc-12668303.creator: Massimo Christian D'Alterio, Miriam Scoti, Rocco Di Girolamo, Giovanni Talarico, Geoffrey W. Coates, Claudio De Rosa
pmc-12668303.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Enantiopure isotactic poly(cyclohexene carbonate) (PCHC) has been synthesized with chiral Zn‐β‐diiminate catalyst. PCHC crystallizes both as enantiopure polymer (R)‐PCHC and (S)‐PCHC and upon stereocomplexation of the two enantiomers. We report the crystal structures of the enantiopure polymer and of the stereocomplex (R/S)‐PCHC and explain their crystallization based on the establishment of multiple attractive H‐‐‐O═C interactions between oxygen atoms of carbonyl groups and the hydrogen atoms of the cyclohexyl rings and C═O‐‐‐C═O intimate dipole interactions between carbonyl groups of chains of opposite chirality

pmc-12786388.title: DMSO solvates of tert-butyl­calix[6]arene and related multisolvent structures
pmc-12786388.creator: Monika Wanat, Ewelina Zaorska, Maura Malinska
pmc-12786388.description: This study highlights how solvent properties, host–guest interaction energies and packing preferences govern the solid-state organization of tert-butyl­calix[6]arene, a macrocycle of importance in separation, molecular recognition and supramolecular chemistry. Introduction Calix[6]arenes are macrocyclic compounds composed of six phenolic units interconnected via methyl­ene bridges at the ortho positions (C-2 and C-6).
